name: drop_item
summary: Toss count items of one kind on the ground (vanilla drop, as Q), optionally facing a block first (e.g. the owner's feet). The stack is taken from the hotbar or moved there from the main inventory; one toss per 10 ticks; the selected slot is restored. Protected kit (swords, pickaxes, shields, bread, worn armour) is refused unless kit_ok (the owner named that exact item). Fewer than count in her inventory ends partial.
